title: Add a SteamDB link to Steam store pages
question: How do I jump from a Steam game page to SteamDB?
answer: Steam store pages have no SteamDB link, but SteamDB uses the same app id as Steam, so a userscript can add one. The usermods script on this page puts a SteamDB button next to the Community Hub button at the top of every Steam store game page. It opens steamdb.info/app/ with the game's id. Without a script, copy the number after /app/ in the store URL and open steamdb.info/app/ followed by that number.
prompt: Add a button to Steam store game pages that opens the same game on SteamDB.
details: The app id comes from the page URL (`/app/292030/...`), and the button reuses Steam's own button style. The script adds nothing else and makes no requests to SteamDB.

alternatives.title: Edit the URL
alternatives.body: Take the number after `/app/` in the store URL and open `https://steamdb.info/app/<number>/`.

alternatives.title: SteamDB extension
alternatives.body: SteamDB's own browser extension adds the link along with prices, lowest-price history and other data on Steam pages. It does much more than this script.

evidence.note: Greasy Fork total installs: "Add SteamDB info" (1,397)
Chrome Web Store users: "SteamDB" (700,000), a multi-purpose extension
Google suggests: steamdb extension, steamdb extension chrome, steamdb extension for steam

check.intact: (() => { const hub = [...document.querySelectorAll('.apphub_OtherSiteInfo a')].find((a) => /Community Hub/.test(a.textContent)); const p = document.querySelector('#game_area_purchase'); return !!hub && hub.checkVisibility() && !!p && p.checkVisibility(); })()
